event: A creak and thud sound as a person stands up from a couch.

sounding_object.description: The section of a large, L-shaped sectional sofa from which the guest (person in green shirt) stands up. The sofa is upholstered in a light gray or beige fabric. The sound is a creak from the sofa structure/springs and a soft thud as the person's weight shifts off it.

reference_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair further from the wall painting
reference_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair with wooden legs, located near the large arched window. It is the armchair further away from the fireplace (which has a mirror/wall painting above it).

facing_object.description: A television set, assumed to be located on or near the wall with the fireplace. The fireplace itself is used as a proxy for its location.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting and facing the tv, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
